description:
Scope of Work

Vendor must be able to provide coworking space funding for a 12-month term at multiple locations nationwide, to support the U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE). The required coworking sites and initial workspace allocations for over 300 FTEs at 90 locations (type to be confirmed) are listed below.

• Term: 12 months of coworking space use, starting upon approval/award.
• Locations: See full site list below.
• Workspace Details: Each site will offer a mix of workstations and private offices.
• Services that must be included:
o Desk or private office
o Wi-Fi access
o Printing privileges (per-site monthly limits)
o Ability to scale up or down based on Government need
o Fulfillment of satisfactory office spaces for no less than 97% of associated personnel (currently 321 of 330 at time of solicitation/award)
